action: Cole knelt at the spring, running cold water over his hands, already planning the tank and filter lines.
thought: Water changes everything. Now we build.

action: Maggie came down from the cabin with empty buckets, watching her family muddy and grinning at the spring.
thought: One good thing on day one—really good.

action: Sawyer crouched beside Cole, running the logistics through his head: filter, tank, gravity feed.
thought: This means no more haul days for water.

action: Finn stood grinning over the trickle of water, vindicated and buzzing with plans.
thought: I knew it! I actually knew it!

action: Bear splashed his hands in the icy water, laughing at how cold it was, soaking his sleeves.
thought: This is the best cold water ever!

description: The spring breaks through on the ridge where Finn urged them to dig, and the family gathers muddy and grinning—Cole assessing the flow, Sawyer thinking logistics, Finn vindicated, Bear splashing, Maggie arriving from the cabin with buckets.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Finn, you absolute legend. You called this.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: I told you! I TOLD you it'd be here!

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: It's so cold! Put your hand here, put your hand here!

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: This changes everything. We won't have to haul water.

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: How far's the cabin from here?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Fifty, sixty yards uphill. We can gravity-feed to a tank.

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: You'd need PVC and a pump, yeah?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Maybe just gravity and a simple filter first. We'll rig it.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: Can we dig deeper? Make it bigger?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: We could, but let's not mess with nature here. This is good.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: Is it safe to drink?

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: We should boil it first, test it. But yes, this is real.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: For now we collect and boil. Come fall, we'll build proper.

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: How much can we use a day?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: As much as comes. Seems pretty steady. Good find, Finn.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: We should make it a place. Like, a water spot.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: With a bucket!

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: We'll need containers, anyway. This is good work today.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Everyone helped dig. This was a team thing.

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: We should mark the path, keep it clear.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: And protect it from animals.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: Can bears drink from it?

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: They do. That's fine. It's their land too.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Alright. Bring some buckets up here before dinner. Let's fill them.

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: On it.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: I'll help carry!

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: Good. Water for tonight, and we'll keep containers full.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: First win of the season. Not bad for day one.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: Told you so.

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: Yes, you did. Come on, everyone—let's get water before lunch.

action: Settles at the table with a warm cup, watching his family gather as the long light fades golden outside.
thought: The land gave us what we came for.

action: Brings the pot from the stove and starts serving bowls of soup, calling everyone in from the evening.
thought: This is how we build a home here.

action: Washes his hands at the basin and pulls up a seat at the table, still thinking about the day's work.
thought: A good day. We're actually doing this.

action: Sits down with barely-contained energy, already talking about tomorrow's plans for the water collection system.
thought: I knew it. The spot was perfect.

action: Climbs into a chair next to Maggie, rubbing his eyes tiredly but grinning, muddy from head to toe.
thought: Warm cabin, full belly, family here.

description: The spring flows cold and clear on the ridge where Finn found it; now evening settles, and all five gather warm in the cabin over steaming soup, muddy and grinning, all together.

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: Hands washed, everyone? You're all still covered in mud.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: Do I have to? I want to eat NOW!

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: Hands, dude. Then we talk about the spring.

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: Finn was right about where to dig. Good call.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Better than good. He nailed it.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: I KNEW it. The land wanted us to find it.

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: The land and your instinct. Come on, everyone.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: What's for dinner? I'm starving!

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: Soup and fresh bread. Nothing fancy but warm.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Fancy enough after today.

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: We did good work, all of us.

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: You did. And you'll do more tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: Tomorrow we build the collection box, right?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: We start on it. Needs to hold water all winter.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: All winter? The spring freezes?

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: We'll figure that out when it gets close.

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: How much time do we have?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Nine weeks, give or take. Plenty to work with.

dialogue.speaker: finn
dialogue.line: We can patch the whole cabin in nine weeks!

dialogue.speaker: sawyer
dialogue.line: Maybe. If we focus and don't get stuck.

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: One step at a time. Eat now. Plan later.

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.line: Smart woman. Come on, boys, dig in.

dialogue.speaker: bear
dialogue.line: Is it hot?

dialogue.speaker: maggie
dialogue.line: Straight from the stove. Be careful.
